label: second copy step in short (L=3/4) sequences + weak t=0 c/q
explanation: Two unrelated components. (A) Strong component, about 83% of activation mass: the copy step at recall_idx == 1 (input is the echoed first original token, output is original token 1) in short sequences. It fires on roughly 78% of L=3 sequences and reaches the top activations (up to 1.0 of max), and on only about 11% of L=4 sequences, more weakly (0.05-0.5). For L>=5 it essentially never fires there. No token pattern explained which L=4 sequences fire (digit or 3/l content did not help). (B) Weak component, about 17% of mass: t=0 when the first input is c or q. This fires on every such sequence (precision 1.0) at a small constant magnitude (~0.02-0.04 of max). Silent everywhere else: the delimiter step, original positions 1+, and copy steps other than recall_idx 1.
